context_for_next_testing_agent: AI-powered KYC verification fully working. When vendors upload documents via POST /api/vendors/kyc/upload/{doc_type}, the system uses GPT-4o-mini vision to: 1) Extract text/data from document images, 2) Cross-check extracted data against vendor-submitted form data, 3) Auto-flag mismatches, 4) Provide AI recommendations (APPROVE/REVIEW/REJECT). Admin KYC review modal shows AI verification badges and extracted data. Razorpay and Instagram Auto-DMs are MOCKED.
